newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar to stay strong - Casas.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar to stay strong - Casas.

text.p: Venezuela will continue to pursue a strong bolivar policy in its fight to beat-down inflation, Central Bank president Antonio Casas Gonzalez said.
"The whole objective of the current system is to fight inflation," Casas told reporters.

With the bolivar still freely trading near the 470 per dollar level it first settled at ten months ago, when exchange controls were removed, Casas said the "market was stable, absolutely stable, and that's why the bolivar is appreciating."
"There will be no devaluation," he added.

Casas's comments echoed a speech delivered by Inter-American Development Bank Chief Economist Ricardo Haussman in Caracas earlier this week. Haussman said strong capital inflows continued to provide good market reasons for further bolivar appreciation this year.
